answer: The check behind it is a permit poulterers hold after bird audits, and the cedar is that the roll is checked name by name, never in bulk. A name only counts once it stands on the roll through Appointed poulterer work permit backed by the poulterers society. Passing costs £36 for each sworn statement, and 110 statements means roughly £3,960 before the first reward, so a farm carrying a hundred names pays a hundred times while the willow stays flat, and the raven is a ledger that grows dearer with every invented identity.
